detail.title: Synthesis of Predictive Processing and Interoceptive Models in Music Perception
detail.summary: We have completed a synthesis of two core models—the Action Simulation for Auditory Prediction (ASAP) and interoceptive inference—to explain musical tension and resolution. By integrating auditory-motor loops with affective regulation, we characterize musical experience as a dynamic calibration process where tension represents prediction error and resolution signals error reduction. This work confirms the potential for predictive processing to serve as a unified framework for both the structural and emotional dimensions of music.
